Summary.Name: DeepECG-CLIP-DINOv3
Summary.Description: Research ECG model: frozen linear-probe heads on the DINOv3-SigLIP2 ECG image encoder (DeepECG-PNG, zo59vdxk, epoch 30), one encoder pass per ECG. Outputs: 77 ECG findings (probabilities), structural heart disease, LVEF <= 40%, LVEF < 50%, incident AFib at 5 years, HCM and acute coronary occlusion.

Mechanism.Output: One row per output: id, label, probability, threshold (validation Youden; none for the 77 findings), positive (only where a threshold exists), applicable. Every enabled head by default; additionalMetadata.heads selects a subset.
Mechanism.Probe_version: clean: heads fitted on features of clean rendered ECG pages (PACS-AI receives native digital ECGs).
Mechanism.Disabled_heads: HCM 3-class and ACCO vs AICO are off by decision (2026-11-26).
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults with a 12-lead resting ECG at the Montreal Heart Institute (development cohorts).
Mechanism.Input_data_source: One ECG per request, chosen from the study: DICOM 12-lead or general ECG waveform first, then an Encapsulated PDF holding a vector ECG (standard 3x4 + lead II rhythm layout), then a single-frame ECG image; earliest acquisition first.
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep learning: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 image encoder (448x896 grayscale page, ImageNet normalisation, bfloat16), StandardScaler + logistic regression heads on its 1536-d feature (code: HeartWise-AI/DeepECG_Docker models/dinov3_bank.py).

Performance.Note: Held-out Montreal Heart Institute test sets, clean rendered pages; 95% CI from 1000 resamples of 80% of patients.
Performance.ACO: AUROC 0.87 (0.84-0.89), sensitivity 0.73, specificity 0.85, NPV 0.98 at threshold 0.0470 (9,021 ECGs, 589 occlusions)

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research on ECG-based detection of these conditions.
Uses_and_directions.Directions: Send the ECG study (waveform preferred). Read each output as a model score; a flag is given only where a validation threshold exists.

Warnings_and_limitations.Research_only: No regulatory clearance, no calibration analysis, no external validation.
Warnings_and_limitations.Input_fidelity: Waveforms sampled at a multiple of 250 Hz give the training pixels exactly; PDFs are redrawn from their vector traces; images are used as they are and are the least validated input.
Warnings_and_limitations.Numerics: Features are computed under bfloat16 autocast, as at probe fitting; GPU kernels differ from the training run's by about 1e-3 in probability (more on steep heads).
Warnings_and_limitations.Provenance_gap: The probe fits recorded no git commit (closest: DeepECG-PNG probe-fairness 08a2933).
Warnings_and_limitations.License: The encoder derives from Meta DINOv3 and is subject to the DINOv3 license.

Résumé.Description: Modèle ECG de recherche : sondes linéaires figées sur l'encodeur d'images ECG DINOv3-SigLIP2. Sorties : 77 constats ECG, cardiopathie structurelle, FEVG <= 40 %, FEVG < 50 %, FA incidente à 5 ans, CMH et occlusion coronarienne aiguë.

Performance.Autres: Cardiopathie structurelle 0,77 ; CMH 0,71 ; FA à 5 ans 0,68 ; 77 constats 0,97 (macro).

Avertissements.Recherche: Usage en recherche seulement ; aucune autorisation réglementaire, aucune validation externe ni analyse d'étalonnage.
Avertissements.Entrées: Le tracé DICOM est l'entrée la plus fidèle ; le PDF vectoriel est redessiné ; l'image est utilisée telle quelle et est la moins validée.
